## Finite compiler witness for operation-owned choice metadata.
app InputChoices
Given
 Country {name:text,active:bool=true}
 Region in Country {name:text}
 Site {name:text}
 Document {site:Site}
 Submission in Document {note:text}
 Employee {user:user,name:text?,role:text,home:Site}
 Parent {site:Site,label:text,kind:text}
 Child in Parent {label:text}
 PrivateParent {site:Site,label:text}
 PrivateChild in PrivateParent {label:text}
 policy Country read=members
 policy Region read=members
 policy Site read=members
 policy Document read=members
 policy Submission read=members
 policy Employee read=members
 policy Parent read=members fields=label,kind
 policy Child read=members
 policy PrivateParent read=owner
 policy PrivateChild read=members
When
 scenario compareParents(first:Child,second:Child) read=true -> bool by=members
  do return first.parent==second.parent
 scenario parentLabel(child:Child) read=true -> text by=members
  do return child.parent.label
 scenario parentKind(child:Child) read=true -> text by=members
  do return child.parent.kind
 scenario parentSite(child:Child) read=true -> Site by=members
  do return child.parent.site
 scenario comparePrivateParents(first:PrivateChild,second:PrivateChild) read=true -> bool by=members
  do return first.parent==second.parent
 scenario privateParentSite(child:PrivateChild) read=true -> Site by=members
  do return child.parent.site
 scenario region_choices(country:Country) read=true -> Region[] by=members
  do return country.Region
 scenario reviewer_choices(document:Document) read=true -> Employee[] by=members
  do return Employee as candidate where candidate.home==document.site
 scenario save(country:Country,region:Region choices={read=region_choices(country=country),labels=["name"]},note:text="Kept" desc="Address note" label="Note") -> Region by=members
  require region.parent==country
  do return region
 scenario assign(submission:Submission,assignee:user?=null choices={read=reviewer_choices(document=submission.parent),value="user",labels=["name","role","home"]} desc="Chosen reviewer" label="Reviewer") -> user? by=members
  require assignee==null or any(Employee as candidate,candidate.user==assignee and candidate.home==submission.parent.site)
  do return assignee
 scenario submit(document:Document,assignee:user?=null choices={read=reviewer_choices(document=document),value="user",labels=["name","role","home"]} desc="Chosen reviewer" label="Reviewer") -> user? by=members
  require assignee==null or any(Employee as candidate,candidate.user==assignee and candidate.home==document.site)
  do return assignee
 scenario copy_site(target:Document,source:Document,accept:bool=true) by=members
  do
   set target {site=source.site}
   require accept
 scenario bindSite(target:Document,site:Site,accept:bool=true) by=members
  do
   set target {site}
   require accept
 scenario reviseSubmission(submission:Submission,note:text) by=members
  do set submission {note}
 scenario assignWithSite(submission:Submission,document:Document,site:Site,assignee:user?=null,accept:bool=true) -> user? by=members
  require submission.parent==document
  do
   set document {site}
   require assignee==null or any(Employee as candidate,candidate.user==assignee and candidate.home==submission.parent.site)
   require accept
   return assignee
Then
